localEmphasis: Iran-relevant availability and existing dated prices where sourced
fa.articles: Preserve the corrected Persian articles; merge the applicable supplied sections.

en.articles: Use language-evidence.en.md instead of translating the Persian-only evaluation article; use cost-choice.en.md for the regional cost replacement.

es.articles: Use language-evidence.es.md and cost-choice.es.md; do not promote Persian-only models by default.

sharedRules: Same factual identifiers across locales; prose may differ.
Changing page language does not change the language of a recorded evaluation.
Do not require all languages to have identical article lists.
Do not use Iran availability/payment assumptions for all Spanish-speaking countries.
Localized article links must resolve to the actual translated or adapted article, not to a Persian fallback disguised as a translation.
